name: menu-bar
title: Menu Bar
description: A fixture for pilot-ext-host's menu-bar commands (T12): a titled item whose menu's rows are pressed, an icon-only item from an asset, and one that asks during its render.
author: banozz

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.description: Its title counts the open tasks; Mark one done in its menu closes one. Loads for 0.3 s and keeps an interval running.

commands.name: dot
commands.title: Dot
commands.description: Icon-only: its icon is the asset dot.png, its menu one row.

commands.name: asker
commands.title: Asker
commands.description: Calls AI.ask and getSelectedText as it renders; its title says how each ended.
